1. The above un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 were reviewed by the Audit Committee and thereafter approved by the Board of Directors at their Meeting held on October 24, 2026.

2. The financial results of the Company have been prepared in accordance with the Indian Accounting Standards notified under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 read with the relevant rules of the Companies ( Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015 as amended from time to time.

3. The Statutory Auditors of the company have carried out the Limited Review of the un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 in accordance with Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligatiosn and Disclosure Requiremetns) Regulations, 2015

4. Segment Reporting - Not Applicable (The Company is exclusively in the transportation business segment)

5. There is no exceptional items.

6. Previous year/period figures have been regrouped/arranged, wherever necessary to make them comparable with the current period figure.

7. The un-audited financial results are also available on the Company's website at www.neccgroup.com and on the websites of the stock exchanges viz, BSE Limited at www.bseindia.com and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited at www.nseindia.com
